value.name: listens for hidden meaning in voicemail
value.description: Asha listens to Eld's voicemail and tries to detect whether his voice has tightened or revealed his intent.
evidence: eld's voice came through the speaker the way it had the first two times—evenly paced, the docket number given without hesitation, the request that she stop by before seven phrased as if he were asking after a calendar conflict rather than anything else—and she listened past the words this time for the small places where his cadence might have tightened.

value.name: drives to the house without checking phone
value.description: After receiving the message, Asha drives on without looking back at the phone, uncertain what Eld's message means.
evidence: by the time the light turned green she could not tell which reading she had brought into the car with her and which one the message itself supported.
She set the phone face down on the passenger seat next to the briefcase and drove the rest of the boulevard without reaching for it again.

value.name: enters dark house quietly
value.description: Asha arrives home, lets herself in, and avoids turning on the hall lamp as she heads inside.
evidence: The house was dark when Asha let herself in, and she did not turn on the hall lamp;

value.name: brings briefcase to study
value.description: Asha carries her briefcase to the study and places it under the lamp she uses for late reading.
evidence: she carried the briefcase straight back to the study and set it on the desk under the green-shaded lamp she kept there for late reading.

value.name: lays out case materials
value.description: Asha opens the briefcase and arranges the documents and notes she will need like legal exhibits.
evidence: She unlatched the case and laid out what she needed in the order she would have laid out exhibits: the printout of Devin's corrected filing with its electronic stamp along the header, a copy of the court's intake confirmation she had pulled off the docket that afternoon, and her own legal pad from Monday with the cross of the caseworker running down two pages in her left-handed shorthand.

value.name: examines envelope from door pocket
value.description: Asha places an envelope beside her other materials and opens it to inspect the clerk's ballpoint number.
